title: Peacock Place
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Peacock Place”, a luxury 5-bed, 5.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 14 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Rooftop Terrace & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights -Private Heated Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $30 per day from October 1 - May 1) -Elevator -Gulf Views -Six Seater Golf Cart Included -Six Adult Bikes Included Experience the perfect blend of comfort and coastal elegance in this stunning multi-level beach retreat. Thoughtfully designed for relaxation and entertainment, this home boasts breathtaking Gulf views, a private heated pool (available for an additional $30/day from October 1 – May 1), and a long list of upscale amenities to elevate your stay. Enjoy effortless convenience with a private elevator, explore the neighborhood in style with a six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes included, and unwind poolside in your own serene oasis. Whether you're planning a family vacation, a couples' getaway, or a group retreat, this well-appointed home offers the space, comfort, and location to make your beachside stay truly unforgettable. Sleeping Arrangements First floor -Queen Over Queen Bunk - Shared Bathroom with Shower -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Second floor -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub Third floor -King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo -King bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower
